annotations.text:
HERO — DESKTOP 1440x900

The one compositional move: the headline overlaps the portrait, and the portrait sits behind it. Line 4 runs 44px under the portrait's left edge; a gradient on the portrait keeps the type readable.

Amber appears in exactly five places: the full stop, three proof ticks, the scroll line, the duotone, the glow.

VARIANT B — NO PORTRAIT

Insurance. If the photography isn't strong enough, this is the fallback: headline steps up to 132px, proof strip rotates onto the right margin, scroll cue goes horizontal.

Worth comparing honestly — this one may be the stronger design.

HERO — MOBILE 390x844

DEVIATION FROM SPEC: five lines, not four. At 390px the four-line break forces 42px type, which undersells the hero. Splitting USEFUL / THINGS. buys 56px.

Headline leads; the portrait never appears above it.

SELECTED WORK

Three entries, alternating sides. Jar Gyi is NOT here — there is no material for it yet beyond a privacy policy, so CDG Zig, BKK Guide MM and Shwe Nar Sin lead instead. Say the word and Jar Gyi takes 01.

The screenshot slots are deliberate placeholders at Play Store dimensions (1080x1920), with registration brackets. Real screenshots drop straight in — no redesign, no resize. I still need the Play Store URLs.

The hover is the payoff the hero deliberately saved: frame lifts, border warms to amber, index rule extends, glow comes up. Hover a row to see it.

FOUNDATIONS

Tokens as an editorial spread rather than a swatch dump.

Body face is Instrument Sans, not Inter as originally specced — Inter is the single most overused UI face and would have undercut the 'made by an engineer with taste' read. Same metrics class, so nothing else moves.

The Accent tweak above each artboard recolours the whole system live.

EXPERIENCE

A spine, not a list. CDG Zig and FWD SG nest UNDER Codigo rather than sitting as peer jobs — that is what they actually are, and it stops one employer reading as three.

The internal Android library is called out by name here. It is your clearest differentiator and the resume buries it as a bullet.

The recognition strip closes the section: ICPC, Hackathon Yangon, UCSY. Personality without an Awards section taking over.

CHECK YOUR RESUME: it has Better HR as Jun–Dec 2022 and Codigo as Oct 2022 onward. Those overlap by three months. Only years are shown here so the site does not expose it, but a recruiter reading the PDF will notice.
